name: Trần Phú Night Market
kicker: The walking street behind 46 Trần Phú
summary: The night market is a 137 m walking street behind the cultural centre at 46 Trần Phú, in Lộc Thọ. The provincial digital guide says entry is free, with 50 stalls and 16 of them food. It names bún chả, chả cá, bánh căn, fried squid, breaded shrimp, ice cream, and six chè bowls. A clock was not printed.
getThere: Behind 46 Trần Phú. You are already on the beach road.
heroCaption: Stalls and the crowd on the night-market walking street
body: The provincial digital guide places the walking street behind the 46 Trần Phú Cultural Center, on Trần Phú in Lộc Thọ. The length is 137 m. Entry is free. Fifty stalls are printed, sixteen of them food. The foods named are bún chả, chả cá, bánh căn, fried squid, breaded shrimp, ice cream, pomelo chè, sương sa hạt lựu chè, ginseng chè, green-bean chè, glutinous rice balls in syrup, and lotus-seed chè. No stall price is printed.

The provincial digital guide calls it a night market. An opening or closing hour was not printed. Come after dark and check the gate. The sand in front of Trần Phú is the other half of this evening. Bánh căn is named here and is not described.

gettingThere: From a hotel on Trần Phú, walk to number 46 and take the street behind the cultural centre. A minute count from the station was not printed.
